args.command:
echo '=== CHATGPT APP ==='; command -v chatgpt || true; dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${Architecture}
' chatgpt 2>/dev/null || true; chatgpt --version 2>/dev/null || true; pgrep -a -f '(^|/)chatgpt( |$)' || true; echo '=== CODEX CLI ==='; command -v codex || true; codex --version 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== DISPLAY ==='; printf 'DISPLAY=%s
WAYLAND_DISPLAY=%s
XDG_SESSION_TYPE=%s
' "${DISPLAY:-}" "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" "${XDG_SESSION_TYPE:-}"

meta.summary: Inspect official ChatGPT Linux app and CX Codex CLI separately on Mini
